statementText: SELECT o.OrderId, c.Name, o.Total FROM dbo.Orders o JOIN dbo.Customers c ON o.CustomerId = c.CustomerId WHERE o.Status = 'completed' AND c.Country = 'DE'

reasons: Scan on dbo.Customers with join predicate on (Country) is part of a Hash Match join and is ~50% of statement cost. An index on the join predicate columns would eliminate the full scan.
